name: Can I stay in my house while the kitchen is being remodeled?

mainEntity.name: Can I stay in my house while the kitchen is being remodeled?

acceptedAnswer.text: Living in your home during a kitchen remodel is possible, especially if you set up a functional temporary prep space elsewhere. However, you must be prepared for temporary utility shutoffs, construction noise, and limited cooking capabilities. If your project involves a total layout overhaul, extensive drywall patching, subfloor repairs, and multiple trade crews, staying elsewhere during the heavy demolition and rough-in phases may reduce stress. We seal off work areas with plastic barriers and clean up daily to minimize dust throughout the rest of your house.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, many homeowners stay by setting up a temporary kitchenette, though relocating during loud demolition and rough-in work can reduce daily disruption.
